memory_update.text: Direct US-listed pure plays in high-purity quartz mining and semiconductor crucibles appear scarce; key names cited in context include private or foreign-primary-listed suppliers.
SHECY should remain the main reference anchor for public quartz/crucible exposure because Shin-Etsu has both semiconductor silicon and quartz/crucible-related businesses.
GLW is a second-order underfollowed semiconductor-materials candidate through HPFS fused silica and majority-owned Hemlock polysilicon, but materiality must be verified.

ASYS is a speculative shadow candidate below the usual market-cap threshold; include only if later evidence links its wafer/substrate processing tools or consumables to quartz, silicon, SiC, or wafer-capacity bottlenecks.
Wafer makers such as GlobalWafers are likely better public read-throughs for crucible constraints than many fab-equipment names, because crucibles are consumed upstream in silicon-wafer production.

node: High-purity quartz, crucibles, and silicon wafer upstream materials
summary: Layer 1B expanded the investable universe around the high-purity quartz and crucible chokepoint. The direct public-market exposure appears scarce: key mined high-purity quartz processors and several crucible makers are private or non-US primary listings. The best US-accessible candidates are therefore a mix of reference leaders with direct quartz/wafer exposure, indirect upstream silicon-material suppliers, and speculative small-cap equipment/materials vendors tied to wafer/substrate processing. No candidate here is a buy/sell recommendation; this is a research-priority universe only.
